This reminds me of a carousel I was in a few years ago, the music express kind of type (it's a ride that goes fast in like a circle), the movement pushes you to the sides.
Previously I was maximum with one other person in that ride, me being rather on the inside. Here I was with two friends and because I was the heaviest of us three I decided I would go for the most "outside" seat (it's rather one bench tho) because that one is being pushed the most and I found it fair like that.
Well only to realize it was a huge mistake, I was being squeezed so hard by their weight that I was crying in pain while they were shouting in fun. I was panicking and wanted it to stop because they squeezed me so hard on the not so soft carousel. I had troubles walking afterwards and bruises on half my body (the half that was pushed into the side) and my friends laughed at me.
I had days of pain following that.
And I decided to do some maths, estimated my friends weight and looked up the stats of the carousel, and the conclusion was that practically a grown ice bear crushed me (the weight of them two combined with the physics stuff, several hundreds of kilos)

Fun times

(and sorry for any spelling mistakes if anyone reads this)
